Priya (People Ops): Quick q — performance review window next week (May 3–10). If someone has PTO that overlaps calibration meetings, do managers need to deny or is there a preferred approval flow?
Ethan (Eng Manager): short answer: don’t auto-deny. managers should coordinate with ICs to reschedule 1:1s or move feedback async where possible. :+1:
Sam (IC): For context: my calibration is on May 4th but I already booked a 2-day trip. Should I cancel or can we move my slot?
Lina (People Ops Lead): We don't force cancellations. People Ops recommends: 1) manager and IC try to swap meeting within the review week; 2) if not possible, manager sends a short write-up summarizing feedback; 3) mark the review as "backup" in the review doc.
Alex (Talent): Also please cc Talent if a change might affect scheduling across multiple panels — we can help rebalance slots.
Ethan (Eng Manager): Will managers get leeway on deadlines? e.g., docs due May 5th — can we accept forks if someone is OOO?
Priya (People Ops): Yes — small extensions ok. Standard guidance: up to 48h extension for short PTO (<=3 days) during the window; anything longer escalate to Lina. We'll document this in the review checklist.
Sam (IC): Helpful — what's the process for short-notice PTO that pops up mid-week?
Lina (People Ops Lead): Short-notice: manager tries to reassign reviewers or record async feedback. If critical calibration conflicts remain, People Ops will reassign a backup reviewer.
Ethan (Eng Manager): One operational ask: can HRbot tag review-related PTO so we can filter in the dashboard?
HRbot: Automated suggestion — add label `review-window` to time-off requests created between May 1–10. Confirm with People Ops to enable.
Priya (People Ops): Good idea. @HRbot please enable the `review-window` tag for May 1–10 and add an automated note on the request: "Flagged for performance review scheduling — manager to coordinate."
HRbot: Done. Tagging enabled for May 1–10. :white_check_mark:
Alex (Talent): I'll update the scheduling doc and ping managers with a short template for write-ups and the 48h extension rule. Template draft: "If you will be OOO for your review slot, please provide a 1-paragraph summary of your recent contributions and any context for calibration."
Sam (IC): Thanks — that template will help.
Ethan (Eng Manager): Will share with my team and try to swap slots first.
Priya (People Ops): Closing note: no blackout on PTO during reviews, but please follow the swap -> async -> tag -> escalate flow. I'll drop the doc link here when live: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PeopleOps/pages/Review+Window+PTO+Guidance
Sam (IC): :thumbsup: Thanks everyone!
